BATATAOU_NAO.Dialog.Title: Potato Or Not?
BATATAOU_NAO.Dialog.BenchmarkRequired: Run the benchmark to unlock Apply — without measurement, any setting is a guess.
BATATAOU_NAO.Dialog.OverrideAbove: You are choosing a level ABOVE what your machine was measured for. This can cause: low FPS, stutters in busy scenes and lag during combat.
BATATAOU_NAO.Dialog.OverrideBelow: You are choosing a level BELOW the recommendation. Your machine can handle more: you will lose shadows, anti-aliasing and animations for nothing.
BATATAOU_NAO.Dialog.OverrideNoFps: Your FPS could not be measured (background tab or unavailable meter). Choose manually — if the game feels heavy, come back here and run the benchmark again.
BATATAOU_NAO.Quality.LowDescription: Absolute minimum. Your computer can't handle more than this.
BATATAOU_NAO.Quality.MediumDescription: Balanced. Acceptable performance for most users.
BATATAOU_NAO.Quality.HighDescription: Everything maxed out. For those with the right hardware.
